title: OP script
features:
🔹 Main Farm

Auto Buy Upgrades: Automatically purchases available tycoon upgrades.

Auto Click Income: Automatically wakes up and activates all income streams.

Auto Upgrade Stands: Upgrades your lemon stands flawlessly.

Auto Collect Fruit: Teleports to and automatically collects all tree fruits.

Auto Phone Offer: Instantly accepts phone offers as soon as they pop up.

🔹 Progression

Auto Rebirth: Fully automated rebirth loops (Updated: Now waits for the timer first!).

Rebirth Time: Choose custom cooldown intervals (5, 10, 20, or 30 minutes).

Auto Ascend: Automatically handles your ascension process.

Auto Evolve: Automatically evolves your tycoon when ready.

Auto Power Upgrade: Automatically levels up your power stats (WalkSpeed,  etc.).

🔹 Bonuses & Games

Auto Minigame Race: Automatically enters and instantly wins minigame races.

Auto Minigame Trade: Automatically triggers and wins minigame trades.

🔹 Settings

Anti-AFK: Prevents Roblox from disconnecting you for idling, allowing 24/7 farming.
